_comment: Every light gun ArcadeMaster recognises, in ONE place: AmPanel (Guns.cs, the Panel Test) and tools/Get-CabinetDevices.ps1 both read this file (Build-AmPanel.ps1 copies it next to AmPanel.exe). usb = VID:PID, or a VID:PID prefix ('D209:16'). names = regular expressions on the name Windows gives a USB device, for guns without a fixed id (Retro Shooter, Blamcon: their makers publish none, Blamcon lets the owner pick one). not = ids that look like a gun but are not (Sinden's camera). Sources (2026-11-27): Sinden - frieds-retrogaming-kit v0.4.0, batocera-linux issue 10795, MiSTerSindenDriver PR 31; GUN4IR - the-sz.com USB ID database (2341:8042 / 8043 'GUN4IR Pro Micro P1 / P2'), IntegrumRetro.ini (8046 / 8047, AE 8037 / 8038); OpenFIRE - RetroBat emulatorlauncher PR 1475, batocera-emulationstation PR 2297 (F143:0001-0004 = P1-P4); GunCon 2 / 3 - MiSTer forum, beardypig GunCon 3 write-up.
